visual_description: A contemporary open‑plan office bathed in soft natural light from large windows. In the foreground, a middle‑aged male manager sits at a sleek white desk, his shoulders slightly hunched as he leans over a stack of printed internal memos and a thick manila file with a bright red tab. He holds a black ball‑point pen, his fingers hovering over a clipboard that bears a simple checklist of three unchecked boxes (the boxes themselves are visible, but no writing). A laptop open in front of him displays a spreadsheet with a few rows highlighted in pale yellow, the screen’s glow reflecting on his thoughtful face. Just beyond the desk, a younger employee stands near a glass partition, his posture lowered, hands clasped around a briefcase, suggesting he has just been called in for questioning. The employee glances sideways toward the manager, his expression tense but silent. The office space includes a few modern chairs, a potted plant in the corner, and a wall‑mounted analog clock showing late afternoon. The lighting is even, with daylight streaming in from the windows, casting gentle shadows that give depth to the scene. The camera is positioned at eye level, slightly angled to capture both the manager’s focused review of documents and the employee’s uneasy stance, creating a single, cohesive composition that conveys an internal investigation and the weight of possible criminal responsibility. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A professional, high-quality photograph of a modern office interior. A middle-aged male manager sits at a sleek desk reviewing a printed document with a checklist. Across from him, a younger employee looks nervous. The scene should convey the gravity of an internal investigation or criminal responsibility review. Natural light, clean composition, 4:5 portrait ratio. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
